parts.note: a bullet is a small missile fired from a gun
to be in a coat is to be covered by it, so covered gives in

explanation.surface: A missile is said to have been wrapped up in some report.
explanation.walkthrough: The second 'in' is a link word joining the wordplay to the definition 'report'.
explanation.definitionFit: A bulletin is a short official news report or statement.

indicators.note: something eaten by another ends up inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a dab is a small flatfish
R is the abbreviation for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A dead monarch has been devoured by a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Drab means dull and colourless, lacking life or spirit.

definitions.note: read as bigot is, a noun for a prejudiced person

indicators.note: something damaged is knocked out of shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A narrow-minded person has wrecked a gate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bigot's' is read as 'bigot is', so the definition is the bigot and 'is' joins it to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: An ageist is a bigot whose prejudice is against people because of their age.

clue.text: Dodgy dealer hides the gold from France in Italy

indicators.note: a container that hides something keeps it inside, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: a fence is a dealer in stolen goods
in French, the gold is l'or

explanation.surface: A crooked trader conceals French gold while in Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a place phrase: the city is one found in Italy, so 'in Italy' stands for it.
explanation.definitionFit: Florence is a city in the Tuscany region of Italy, so the clue's place phrase points to it.

clue.text: Old resident in charge in outlaw nation

indicators.note: one thing in another sits inside it, so these pieces go within the charge

parts.note: a rate is a charge or fee
a guest is a resident staying at a hotel

explanation.surface: An elderly resident holds the reins in a country that defies international law.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'in' is the container signal; the second 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A rogue state is a country seen as flouting international law, an outlaw among nations.

parts.note: to sever is to cut off or disconnect

indicators.note: initially means at the start, so take the first letter of the word electricity

explanation.surface: A warning that cutting off the power is risky.
explanation.definitionFit: A severe illness or storm is a serious, dangerous one.

parts.note: something that is out is not acceptable, as in that's out of the question
the Tories are the political right in Britain

explanation.surface: Calling a Conservative completely beyond the pale.
explanation.walkthrough: TORY is the name for a member of Britain's Conservative Party, a party of the right.
explanation.definitionFit: Outright means completely or wholly, as in rejected outright.

clue.text: Parish priest wears hat and bib

indicators.note: a hat that is worn has the wearer inside it, so the priest goes within the hat

parts.note: tile is old slang for a hat

explanation.surface: A local clergyman is dressed in a hat and a bib.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bib' looks like the garment, but it is the verb to drink, especially habitually.
explanation.definitionFit: To tipple is to drink alcohol regularly, which is what to bib means.

indicators.note: to tour a place is to go round it, so the duffer surrounds the county's letters

parts.note: a loon is a foolish person, a duffer
Kent is a county in South East England, abbreviated SE

explanation.surface: An incompetent is let loose to travel around a county.
explanation.walkthrough: KENT is a county in the south-east of England, hence SE.
explanation.definitionFit: To loosen a grip or a knot is to release it.

clue.text: Good politician is fluent and plausible

parts.note: a Lib is a Liberal, a politician of that party

explanation.surface: A decent politician speaks smoothly and convincingly.
explanation.definitionFit: Glib describes talk that is smooth and persuasive but shallow.

clue.text: International dealer retains a French pimp

indicators.note: to retain something is to hold it within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: an importer deals in goods from abroad
un is French for a

explanation.surface: A trader working abroad keeps on a French procurer.
explanation.definitionFit: An importuner pesters people with solicitations, as a pimp does touting for custom.

parts.note: a trait is a distinguishing feature

explanation.surface: A distinctive characteristic of a noise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like noise, but it is a narrow sea channel.
explanation.definitionFit: A sound is a narrow stretch of water, which a strait also is.

indicators.note: to induce is to bring about by working on, so these letters are made into something new

explanation.surface: Someone from Paris was persuaded to wish for something.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspiration is a hope or ambition.

parts.note: to land something is to get it, as in land a job
a sibyl was a prophetess, a seer

explanation.surface: An instruction to acquire a prophetess and an artist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a' is a link word. Sir Edwin Landseer was the Victorian painter of animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Edwin Landseer was an English painter famous for his animal pictures.

clue.text: Pipe fitting drops very quietly in the river

indicators.note: one thing in another sits inside it, so the quiet letters go within the river

parts.note: the Nile is the river of Egypt
pp, pianissimo, is the musical direction for very quietly

explanation.surface: A plumbing part is silently dropped into a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drops' is a link word joining the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A nipple is a short threaded piece of pipe used to join fittings.

indicators.note: someone tipsy is unsteady, so these letters are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: A soft drink got Noel drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Lemonade is a soft drink made with lemons.

definitions.meaning: to watch is to look at
one's bearing or ... is a respect or relation, as in in this ...

explanation.definitionFit: To regard is to watch closely; a regard is also the aspect or bearing one thing has on another.

parts.note: to dump is to scrap or throw away
the ling is a long sea fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A meal made out of leftover fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A dumpling is a ball of dough cooked as food.

parts.note: to end something is to complete it
giving someone an ear is giving them attention

explanation.surface: Victory comes from listening fully.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Win' is the verb as in win over; 'when giving' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To endear yourself to someone is to win their affection.

clue.text: The way scholar is caught by feeble fielder

indicators.note: something caught by another is held inside it, so these pieces go within

parts.note: a feeble excuse is a thin one
RD is the abbreviation for road, a way
MA, Master of Arts, is a scholar's degree

explanation.surface: A learned man on the road is caught out by a weak fielder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The' is a link word. THIRD MAN is a cricket fielding position behind the batsman on the off side.
explanation.definitionFit: Third man is a fielding position in cricket, so the player there is a fielder.

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece over another comes before it

parts.note: a hoot is a laugh
Ch is the abbreviation for chaplain

explanation.surface: A clergyman laughs while distilling illicit spirits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'making' is a link. POTEEN is illicit Irish whiskey; hooch is moonshine.
explanation.definitionFit: Hootch, or hooch, is illicitly made liquor, as is Irish poteen.

indicators.note: something upset is knocked over, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A physician pictured his squad in disarray.
explanation.definitionFit: Dreamt is a past tense of dream, meaning imagined.

indicators.note: in a down clue, a supporting piece sits under another, so it comes after

parts.note: D is the international vehicle code for Germany
a test is an international match, as in cricket or rugby

explanation.surface: Hating an England international match against Germany.
explanation.walkthrough: A TEST is a full international match in cricket or rugby.
explanation.definitionFit: To detest is to hate intensely, which is what to abhor means.

clue.text: German leader introduced to abstemious company

indicators.note: something introduced to another is put inside it

parts.note: continent means self-restrained, abstemious

indicators.note: a leader comes first, so take the first letter of the word German

explanation.surface: A German head is presented to a teetotal group.
explanation.definitionFit: A contingent is a group of people forming part of a larger gathering, a company.

parts.note: ale is a type of beer

explanation.surface: Penny enjoys beer with a savoury pastry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pasty' looks like the pastry, but it is the adjective for pale-faced; 'has' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Pasty as an adjective means unhealthily pale in complexion.

parts.note: par is the usual or normal level

explanation.surface: The normal moment for farewells.
explanation.definitionFit: To part is to separate, to take leave of one another.

parts.note: ac, account, is a bill
cord is corduroy, a ribbed fabric

explanation.surface: Hand someone a bill for corduroy.
explanation.definitionFit: To accord someone something is to grant or give it to them.

parts.note: a rest is a support, as for a snooker cue
a ring is a group or gang

explanation.surface: A band's backing group look after their instruments.
explanation.definitionFit: Fitting new strings is routine upkeep for a guitar.
